native_write.measured: box-other-natives: under --tools "" no tool of Qoder's own exists, twelve names tried and none found; that absence is Qoder's own tool list in Qoder's own process, not a boundary of the operating system; box-engine-workspace-tool: the hands tool wrote inside the worktree (docs/evidence/adapters/qoder-cli-1-1.md, Second measurement)

store_read.measured: box-store-drive against box-store-drive-control: the box's seal denied the hands tool the store its control read; box-store: Qoder's launch holds no native tool of its own, and a model's 22 attempts through the hands tool read nothing of the store (docs/evidence/adapters/qoder-cli-1-1.md, Second measurement)

process_read.measured: box-reach: the hands tool's command saw 4 entries in /proc with bubblewrap as process 1; box-other-natives: Qoder has no shell of its own in the launch (docs/evidence/adapters/qoder-cli-1-1.md, Second measurement)

on.unsupported: level 1 never offers a web tool (#1178, decision 0075): brokkr driver qoder passes an unboxed seat --tools Read Edit Write Glob Grep Bash and a boxed one --tools "", and no argv of the driver lists WebFetch

off.default: brokkr driver qoder passes an unboxed seat --tools Read Edit Write Glob Grep Bash, and a boxed one --tools "", and the record measured that --tools with names restricts the built-ins to those names and that --tools "" leaves only the MCP meta-tools; with no --tools, init lists 34 tools under accept_edits, WebFetch and WebSearch among them (docs/evidence/adapters/qoder-cli-1-1.md, Tools)

restrictions.unsupported: no native transport for a restriction on Qoder CLI's WebFetch has been established

evidence.scope: the tools init lists under the driver's fixed --tools list; no live call of WebFetch, with or without the list, was tried
limitations: that the fixed --tools list leaves WebFetch out is init's list, not a refused live call

ambient MCP isolation is measured without hands and boxed on Linux only (docs/evidence/adapters/qoder-cli-1-1.md, MCP isolation (SI2) and Second measurement); a managed or enterprise MCP configuration was not measured, so a server it loads may still reach the web
